verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents a first-party Docker self-host path. A release note about Kubernetes probes suggests official k8s manifests exist, but the pack contains no dedicated, maintained guide for any of the named targets. missing for 10: a documented Docker Compose guide, a Kubernetes/Helm guide or chart documentation, a small-VPS deployment guide, a Raspberry Pi/ARM guide, and independent corroboration of these deployment paths.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, official deployment paths cover my target — Docker Compose, Kubernetes/Helm, a small VPS, or a Raspberry Pi — each with its own maintained guide
